title: Volkswagen and Xpeng Secure China Approvals for Public Road Autonomous Driving Trials

tickers.name: XPeng Inc. American depositary shares, each representing two Class A ordinary shares

summary:
Volkswagen's China unit will test Level 3 autonomous driving systems in the city of Hefei after obtaining government permission to operate on public roads. Xpeng has similarly received authorization to trial its Level 4 autonomous technology on public roads throughout the country.

The move comes after a safety review of self-driving systems and marks a renewed effort by Chinese regulators to expand the larger-scale deployment of the technology.
